mapper.sql: field_id, field_creator_id, field_create_time, field_update_time, field_start_time, field_end_time, field_name, field_content, field_type
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.field_id, m.field_creator_id, m.field_create_time, m.field_update_time, m.field_start_time, m.field_end_time, m.field_name, m.field_content, m.field_type FROM sys_calendar_main m LEFT JOIN sys_calendar_persons p ON p.field_calendar_id = m.field_id WHERE (m.field_creator_id = #{userId} OR p.field_person_id = #{userId}) AND YEAR(m.field_start_time) = #{model.year} AND MONTH(m.field_start_time) = #{model.month} ORDER BY m.field_start_time ASC
SELECT FROM sys_calendar_main WHERE field_end_time < #{deadline} ORDER BY field_end_time ASC
